authKeyFile.description:
A file containing the auth key.
Tailscale will be automatically started if provided.

Services that bind to Tailscale IPs should order using {option}`systemd.services.<name>.after` `tailscaled-autoconnect.service`.

authKeyParameters.description:
Extra parameters to pass after the auth key.
See <https://tailscale.com/kb/1215/oauth-clients#registering-new-nodes-using-oauth-credentials>

derper.configureNginx.description:
Whether to enable nginx reverse proxy for derper.
When enabled, nginx will proxy requests to the derper service.

derper.domain.description: Domain name under which the derper server is reachable.

derper.enable.description: Whether to enable Tailscale Derper. See upstream doc <https://tailscale.com/kb/1118/custom-derp-servers> how to configure it on clients.

derper.openFirewall.description:
Whether to open the firewall for the specified port.
Derper requires the used ports to be opened, otherwise it doesn't work as expected.

derper.port.description: The port the derper process will listen on. This is not the port tailscale will connect to.

derper.stunPort.description:
STUN port to listen on.
See online docs <https://tailscale.com/kb/1118/custom-derp-servers#prerequisites> on how to configure a different external port.

derper.verifyClients.description: Whether to verify clients against a locally running tailscale daemon if they are allowed to connect to this node or not.

disableTaildrop.description: Whether to disable the Taildrop feature for sending files between nodes.

disableUpstreamLogging.description: Whether to disable Tailscaled from sending debug logging upstream.

enable.description: Whether to enable Tailscale client daemon.

extraSetFlags.description: Extra flags to pass to {command}`tailscale set`.

extraUpFlags.description: Extra flags to pass to {command}`tailscale up`. Only applied if {option}`services.tailscale.authKeyFile` is specified.

interfaceName.description: The interface name for tunnel traffic. Use "userspace-networking" (beta) to not use TUN.

openFirewall.description: Whether to open the firewall for the specified port.

permitCertUid.description: Username or user ID of the user allowed to to fetch Tailscale TLS certificates for the node.

port.description: The port to listen on for tunnel traffic (0=autoselect).

useRoutingFeatures.description:
Enables settings required for Tailscale's routing features like subnet routers and exit nodes.

To use these these features, you will still need to call `sudo tailscale up` with the relevant flags like `--advertise-exit-node` and `--exit-node`.

When set to `client` or `both`, reverse path filtering will be set to loose instead of strict.
When set to `server` or `both`, IP forwarding will be enabled.
